data.name: Nawaaf
data.gender_notes: Nawaaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-f', which means 'to rest'. This name is often used to describe a peaceful, calming environment or a tranquil soul. In Islamic history, Nawaaf is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for his wisdom and righteousness. The name Nawaaf carries the meaning “Rest, repose, tranquility” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawaaf usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, repose, tranquility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes peace and inner calm.
data.etymology: Nawaaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rest, repose, tranquility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawaaf total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
